card.excerpt: Lovable makes the build fast. We make it something your company can run on.

sections.subheading: Lovable makes the build fast. We make it something your company can run on.

details.label: o3 expertise:
items: Dialed: our own operations app, built in Lovable

panels.heading: SaaS Audit & Replacement Planning
panels.note: Find the tools you pay the most for and love the least
panels.body: We went line by line through our own software spend and found a pattern: premium prices for tools that fit at maybe 70 percent, with workarounds and side spreadsheets covering the rest. We run the same audit on your stack and come back with the tools worth replacing.

details.label: What we look for:
items: Tools that fit at 70 percent, priced at 100
Workarounds and spreadsheets on the side

details.label: what you get:
items: A shortlist of replaceable tools, each with the cost of keeping it and the cost of replacing it.

panels.heading: Custom Builds in Lovable
panels.note: Software shaped around exactly how you work
panels.body: We build the replacement in Lovable, shaped around how your team actually operates — the features you use, built the way you use them, and nothing you don't. Ours is called Dialed: resource planning and financial operations, with Slack, Harvest, HubSpot, and Bamboo wired in. It replaced a $35,000-a-year tool.

details.label: What Dialed proved:
items: A $35,000 SaaS tool replaced for $127 in AI credits
527 prompts and under 40 hours of effort
Fixes and enhancements ship in a few prompts

details.label: what you get:
items: An app that bends to your process instead of the other way around.

panels.heading: Prototype-to-Production Hardening
panels.note: The gap where vibe-coding stories fall apart
panels.body: A prototype that works in a demo is not a product your company can run its finances on. Our security and deployment framework closes that gap — the unglamorous engineering that turns "this works" into "this is trusted." Dialed went through it, and the process is repeatable.

details.label: what you get:
items: An app your company can trust with real work, and a process your IT team can inspect.

features.heading: We run our own company on it.
features.body: Dialed handles O3's resource planning and financial operations. We built it in Lovable, hardened it with the same framework we offer you, and use it every day.

features.heading: Speed needs discipline behind it.
features.body: The AI tools compress the build. Twenty-one years of shipping production software for enterprise clients is what makes the result trustworthy. You need both, and we bring both.

features.heading: The path is repeatable.
features.body: Audit the spend, build the replacement, harden it for production. Dialed was the first trip down that path; the same process is ready to run for your organization.

features.heading: You're paying premium prices for a tool that fits at 70 percent
features.body: The missing 30 percent shows up as workarounds, side spreadsheets, and features you pay for but never touch. We build the replacement that fits how you actually operate — all of it.

features.heading: Your team has a prototype nobody will put in production
features.body: The demo works; the security review, access controls, and deployment pipeline don't exist yet. We harden it into something your IT and security teams can sign off on.

features.heading: Custom software never used to make the budget
features.body: A year ago, an internal tool couldn't justify its build cost. That math has changed — ours cost $127 in AI credits — and we'll help you find where it has changed for you.

features.heading: Replacements for the SaaS you've outgrown
Fixes and enhancements in a few prompts
One team from first prompt to production

sections.heading: Which tool in your stack is worth replacing?
sections.body: Pull up your renewals for the next 12 months and find the tools you pay the most for and love the least. We'll tell you what a replacement costs now.
